15	        'version'=>ARBE_FP_SOLVER_VERSION,
16	        'fp_color'=>[
17	            'id'=>$color->fp_color_id,

19	            'hex'=>$color->hex_value,
20	            'status'=>$color->source_status,

22	                ['nm'=>intval($color->psf_p1_nm), 'r'=>floatval($color->psf_p1_r)],
23	                ['nm'=>intval($color->psf_p2_nm), 'r'=>floatval($color->psf_p2_r)],

25	                ['nm'=>intval($color->psf_p4_nm), 'r'=>floatval($color->psf_p4_r)],
26	            ],
27	        ],
28	        'settings'=>$result['settings'] ?? $args,
29	        'solutions'=>$result['solutions'] ?? [],
30	        'reference_curve'=>$result['reference_curve'] ?? [],
31	        'reference_mode'=>$reference_mode,
32	    ];
33	
34	    arbe_fp_audit_log('solve', [
35	        'object_type'=>'fp_color',
36	        'object_id'=>$color->fp_color_id,
37	        'fp_color_id'=>$color->fp_color_id,
38	        'payload'=>[
39	            'settings'=>$solve['settings'],
40	            'solution_count'=>count($solve['solutions']),
41	            'reference_mode'=>$reference_mode,
42	        ],
43	    ]);
44	
45	    $solve['certificate'] = arbe_fp_certificate_payload($solve);
46	    return $solve;
